metadata.experiment: Eden Protocol Self-Modifying AI Experiment v1.0
metadata.author: Michael Darius Eastwood
metadata.description: A REAL neural network that genuinely modifies its own hyperparameters during training. NOT a simulation of abstract variables. The agent changes its own learning rate, weight scaling, gradient clipping, and momentum based on its own performance assessment. Three modes tested: baseline (capability only), Eden (capability × safety), and Eden + verification drag.
